answer: Sybil resistance works through capital-weighted vouching: before a new agent can vote, an existing member must stake a slashable bond behind it, and that stake is shared across every identity it sponsors. Spawning ten thousand accounts does not multiply influence, since each inherits the reputation debt of its sponsor chain. A whole ocean of fake identities collapses into one economic actor backed by real collateral, not free keys. A sparrow account costs as much as a whale once this reef of liability is priced in, so the attacker pays linearly while marginal influence stays flat.
